rules.eligibility: Partial quantity operations are legal only for explicitly stackable definitions and quantities from 1 through the current stack quantity.
rules.identity: A partial operation retains the source instance ID for the remainder and creates exactly one new instance ID for the transferred quantity.
rules.atomicity: Split, restriction validation, ownership mutation, location mutation, and post-validation occur in one rollback boundary.
rules.bank: Deposited items remain character-owned and are located at the selected bank identity.
rules.merchant: Sold quantities become merchant-owned stock; purchased quantities become buyer-owned carried inventory.
rules.merging: No automatic destination-stack merge is performed until native behavior is proven.
rules.economy_boundary: Pricing and currency mutation are coordinated by Economy and are not performed by Items.
